review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Recomputed matched-N=1e10 amplification ratios for k=3..10 from {1,k} and {2,k} logs
Recomputed power-law fits at 1e10 (8 points) and 1e11 (3 points)
Checked that the page correctly downgraded the inverse-square headline after the mismatched-N audit

claim_reviews.claim: Matched N=1e10 amplification ratios: 243, 152, 107, 73.8, 64.6, 54.6, 46.6, 42.5 for k=3..10.
claim_reviews.evidence: Ratios recomputed from paired density logs (e.g. 11.0568/0.04549≈243.1).

claim_reviews.claim: Matched 1e11 data currently only for k=3,4,5; fit ≈3562·k^(-1.93) is suggestive but underdetermined.
claim_reviews.evidence: Ratios ≈424/249/158; three-point fit α≈-1.931. Page correctly treats inverse-square as a hypothesis.

claim_reviews.claim: Digit 1 strongly amplifies density relative to digit 2 (order 40×–400×).
claim_reviews.evidence: Unambiguous from matched-N tables; this is the durable scientific claim after revision.

claim_reviews.claim: {1,3,5} exception counts 75547→80431→80945 with extrapolated finite limit ≈81005.
claim_reviews.evidence: Counts verified in logs. The limit is an extrapolation, not a theorem. Notably gpu_A135_1e12.log reports Uncovered:80956 and is not cited on this page.

missing_references: Matched {2,k} runs at 1e11 for k=6..10 before claiming inverse-square
Cite A135@1e12 (80956) in the convergence discussion
overall_assessment: This page is a model of scientific self-correction: after the mismatched-N critique, it kept the strong amplification phenomenon and demoted inverse-square to a hypothesis. That posture is correct. Certification should remain bronze until matched larger-N {2,k} data exist.
recommendations: Complete matched 1e11 {2,k} for k=6..10 before any k^{-2} claim
Incorporate A135@1e12 into the finite-limit discussion with explicit extrapolation language
Keep the current title/status wording — it is honest
certification_justification: Strong confirmed amplification; inverse-square law explicitly unconfirmed. Bronze matches the page's own revised epistemic status.
